pages.title: Dragon Scales as Blades
pages.text: Dragon Scales, Obsidiansteel and Draco Arcanus Staffs form this set of tools and weapons.
Kill Wither Skeletons with the Draco axe for +30% skull drop chance.

pages.title: Melee Attributes
pages.text: Damage / Attack Speed:$(br)Sword: 12 / 1.8$(br)Pickaxe: 10 / 1.4$(br)Axe: 14 / 1.2$(br)Shovel: 10.5 / 1.2$(br)Hoe: 4 / 5$(br2)Upgraded tooltips show the final attributes directly.

pages.title: Take a Wither Skull
pages.text: A mainhand Draco axe melee kill adds 30 percentage points to a Wither Skeleton's skull chance: 32.5% without Looting, 35.5% with Looting III. At most one skull drops. Ranged kills cannot borrow this bonus.
